technical.summary: Strong trend structure with golden cross and price above all MAs, but extreme overbought conditions across multiple oscillators create pullback risk; better suited for continuation on dips than immediate entry.

fundamental.summary: IBM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 89 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (287) indicates extreme market fear, and macro score of -4 reflects deteriorating conditions; earnings in 89 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross with price above all major MAs, strong ADX trend, and supertrend bullish signal create structural upside setup, amplified by extreme market fear (33/100) presenting contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions across RSI-9 (96.34), RSI-14 (89.83), stochastic (95.5), and MFI combined with zero active entry crossovers, narrow Bollinger Bandwidth (0.208), and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, macro score -4) create imminent pullback risk that outweighs trend strength.
